claim: The UserAuthentication category of user pool operations (sign-in with InitiateAuth, RespondToAuthChallenge, token refresh and managed login sign-in) has a default quota of 120 requests per second, and it is adjustable.
question: What is the default Amazon Cognito user pool request rate quota for user sign-in (UserAuthentication), and can it be raised?

values.spoken: one hundred twenty requests per second

qualifiers.scope: per account, per Region (all user pools)
